conclusions.observed: Native retains one user turn across separately completed physical utterances and can answer from prior context without a new client delegation. No raw completion/delegation was dropped by the application in the failed questions. The fresh-tool output gate remains closed, as required.
conclusions.contract_defect: The application cannot treat Native user turn.done as a guaranteed per-utterance boundary or prompt-only delegation as a guaranteed every-question SQLite trigger.
conclusions.provider_internal_reason_for_non_respons: unknown; not inferred as quota, fixed question count, byte cap, repetition filter or transport loss
conclusions.prompt_control: Ten delegated questions and 34194 host bytes succeeded before the eleventh missed completion/delegation; not a fix.
conclusions.remaining_decision: Changing question framing/tool ownership to the host is a material departure from the existing native-final/new-delegation admission contract. No such cutover is made without approval.
conclusions.keyword_assertion_limit: Presence of expected fact strings is not a full semantic correctness check; one budget answer also contained a contradictory no-data clause.
